messages:
Maya: Quick UX thread — propose a compact preflight "priority bar" that shows top 3 issues (impact-ranked) with 1-line fixes and an expand chevron for full logs. Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW_UI

Devon: Love it. Keep primary action obvious: Expand vs Retry. Make copy button accessible on the expanded header, small icon on the bar for quick copy.

Alex: Backend will need to return structured checks: id, severity, impact_rank, title, short_fix, raw_log_url, kb_slug. Current probe is text only; I'll draft the contract.

ops-bot: Preflight run: 2026-05-12T14:11:09Z — 24 checks: 3 high, 4 medium, 17 ok. Raw: https://internal/preflight/2201234567/log.txt. Fields: stdout, stderr, exit_code.

Keisha: Microcopy attempt: Header: "Preflight done — 24 checks, 3 issues" Bar item: "Registry unreachable — Quick fix: allow outbound HTTPS (443)". For mobile shorten to "Registry unreachable — Fix: allow 443". Avoid infra jargon.

Jamal: Accessibility: include explicit text labels (Fail/Warning/OK) on the bar, not just color. Use aria-live="polite" for the summary and aria-controls/aria-expanded on expand buttons. When logs open, move focus to the log heading and provide a skip link back.

Maya: UX Q: show "Why this matters" inline for high-impact items only to limit clutter. Link to KB for others. Thoughts?

Devon: Sounds good. Feature-flag the inline sentence so we can A/B test support ticket rate. Also flag collapse-logs-by-default.

Alex: I'll add flags to frontend config. Timeline: API contract by Tue, frontend prototype next sprint. Keisha/Jamal pls review copy/a11y after Figma update.

Maya: I'll update Figma with the bar, inline helpers for high items, copy icon placement, and keyboard flows. Will post link and tag reviewers when ready. :thumbsup:
